about: خطة معرض العرض (المخطط §9) — يقرؤها scripts/make-showcase.ts. البرومبتات بالإنجليزي (أدق للنماذج)، بلا علامات تجارية حقيقية، والشخصيات مولّدة فقط.

hero.prompt: One continuous cinematic shot: a falcon glides low over golden desert dunes toward ancient sandstone cliffs at sunset; the camera follows just behind its wings, then rises to reveal the vast glowing horizon. Warm amber light, drifting dust particles, calm and epic, natural motion, film grain, no text.

families.video:kling: Slow-motion tracking shot of a white Arabian horse galloping along the shore at golden hour, sea spray and sand kicking up, mane flowing, low camera close to the waterline, warm backlight, cinematic depth of field.
families.video:seedance: Macro 180-degree orbit around a dark oud perfume bottle on black marble, thin smoke curling around the glass, a single warm spotlight sliding across gold engraving, reflections on the marble, premium commercial look.
families.video:veo: Aerial drone shot at blue hour over a modern Gulf city skyline, glass towers lighting up, traffic light trails on wide boulevards, slow forward glide, soft haze, cinematic.
families.video:wan: Close-up slow motion of golden Saudi coffee being poured from a brass dallah into a small white finjan, steam rising, cardamom pods and dates on a wooden tray, warm morning light.
families.video:hailuo: Slow dolly-in at golden hour across desert dunes: wind lifts fine sand off a dune crest in glowing ribbons, a brass dallah on a woven rug in the foreground, sandstone cliffs in soft haze behind, warm amber and teal grade.
families.video:grok-video: A falcon takes off from a falconer's leather glove in slow motion, wings spreading wide against a clear desert sky, feathers in sharp detail, dust swirling below, camera tilts up to follow.

families.video:luma-ray: Underwater shot in the Red Sea: sunlight rays dance over a colorful coral reef, schools of small fish part around the camera as it glides forward, clear turquoise water, calm and vivid.
families.video:pixverse: An unbranded white sneaker slowly rotating on a glossy podium, colored light streaks sweeping across it, floating dust in the beams, dark studio background, crisp product commercial.

families.video:heygen-video: A friendly presenter in a bright modern studio smiles and gestures toward a new cup of specialty coffee on the table, natural lighting, medium shot, clean commercial style.
